name: Audio input token count explodes relative to text output
workarounds: Use 30-second windowing (Whisper's max_source_positions=1500 at 50Hz mel frame rate)
Use VAD to skip non-speech segments
Use streaming ASR for long audio (with quality tradeoff)
notes: HARDWARE PARAMETERS, NOT RECORD IDS. 2026-10-04: affected_by_hardware previously held ['gpu-vram', 'memory-bandwidth'] - hardware quantities, not products. They could never resolve, so the repo was carrying permanent false debt against a budget that exists to catch NEW bad references. Moved into this note; the field is now EMPTY and that is the correct value, not a gap. Why: These were hardware PARAMETERS ('gpu-vram', 'memory-bandwidth'), not products. But the record is ALSO part-independent - it is derived from Whisper model configs across five model sizes, so naming any GPU would INVENT a hardware dependency it does not claim.
